program.blurb: Every day a different subject from the library, and all twenty before any comes back.
program.about: Every day borrows a different subject from the library. Chest one day, conditioning the next, then Pilates, calves, running prep, fighter legs and more. All twenty come once before any comes back, each time in a different format. Strength days end with a short burst of cardio or core; the rest end with a short lift. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
